data.why: app.py tries the live FOPH API on startup and, since the sandboxed server has no network, always falls back to the bundled historical_data/bag_flu_data_20261025.pkl pickle already shipped in the repo, so no files need to be copied or written.

goals: Check the latest weekly influenza incidence status for Switzerland and see whether it is rising or falling
Compare incidence trends across age groups, sex, canton, and virus type over an adjustable look-back window
Spot which cantons currently have the highest reported incidence on the history map
Assess the relative share (proportion) of cases by subgroup using the area plots
Tune color thresholds to highlight weeks or cantons exceeding a chosen incidence level

review.summary: The tree fits what the app says it is for: an overview of the current Swiss flu situation plus history pages that put it in context. Its phases follow the app's real stages, and most cited screens show what their nodes say. It needs a few fixes before filing: t9 claims the incidence map was rescaled when its screen shows it still saturated, t6 cites the wrong screen, and the tree is missing tasks for comparing the current season with past ones and for checking how fresh the data is.
